definitions.gloss: stick gum; slab gum; flat chewing gum
definitions.explanation: Chewing gum in the traditional flat, rectangular stick form, as opposed to pellet-type gum (粒ガム). A common everyday product in Japan.

examples.japanese: {板|いた}ガムを{一枚|いちまい}{噛|か}む。
examples.english: To chew a stick of gum.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{板|いた}ガムより{粒|つぶ}ガムのほうが{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: Recently, pellet gum is more popular than stick gum.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どものころ、{駄菓子屋|だがしや}で{板|いた}ガムをよく{買|か}っていた。
examples.english: When I was a kid, I often bought stick gum at the penny candy store.

notes:
Compound of {板|いた} (flat board) + ガム (gum). Refers to the traditional flat, rectangular stick form of chewing gum.

COUNTER:
Counted with {枚|まい} (counter for flat things): {一枚|いちまい}、{二枚|にまい}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {板|いた}ガム: stick/slab gum (traditional flat shape)
- {粒|つぶ}ガム: pellet gum (small, coated pieces — now more popular)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {板|いた}ガムを{噛|か}む (to chew stick gum)
- {板|いた}ガムを{一枚|いちまい} (one piece of stick gum)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{粒|つぶ}ガム has largely overtaken {板|いた}ガム in market share in Japan. Classic {板|いた}ガム brands include ロッテのクールミント and グリーンガム, which have nostalgic appeal.
